title: checklist: v18.5.0 sweep close-out, batch C: item-text re-points in `platform-core.json`, `cli.json` (with the `cli-18-prerelease-db` recipe)
body:
domain:devx#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQTVjryTSkqydKVS6z

Carries the batch-C item-text re-points of #33761 (the v18.5.0 release test sweep anchor); #33761 keeps the other batches, the runner kit and the coverage card. Filing gate ①: the follow-up owed by in-flight work. The anchor's step-1 ledger (comment 6896511848, read at `origin/main` `895783a1`) has 138 item-text re-point rows over about 104 items, too many for one PR; the seat split them by area-file family, one card per family with no shared file (the #32908 precedent, split comment 6881136418). ⛔ Not a claim.

## Scope

- Files: `platform-core.json`, `cli.json` (with the `cli-18-prerelease-db` recipe) under `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/` (and `docs/qa/platform-checklist/coverage.json` only if a gate regenerates it).
- Rows of ledger 6896511848 (disposition `item-text re-point`, 20 (plus the recipe) items): 1 4 5 6 8 36 37 42 44 47 48 89 90 106 108 110 122 123 124 125 183 185 186 194 199 214 216 218
- Rows repeated across rounds are one edit each. Every row is re-read at `origin/main` first; the edit starts from the measured residue, not the parked text.
- Each edited item: `revision` +1 and one `history` row (ref = the PR number). The area JSON is not canonical `JSON.stringify`: edit text spans, never re-serialise.
- ⛔ No product package, no `ui/**`, no `scripts/qa/**`, no `RUNNER.md` (the runner-kit card carries those). ⛔ Not the items #33859, #33860 and #33842 carry.
- Serial: after PRs #33931 (`platform-core.json`) and #33929 (`cli.json`) merge; the dev starts from `origin/main` with both in.

## Acceptance

- Every row above is edited or answered on the PR with a reading (already right at the PR's base, or moved to another carrier).
- `check:platform-checklist` and the derived gate families pass.

Priority p1, inherited from #33761 (release acceptance evidence).
